v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Allelúia, * Dóminus regnávit, decórem índuit, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: Alleluia, * The Lord hath reigned, he is clothed with beauty, alleluia, alleluia.
Shout with joy to God * all the earth, alleluia.

text.la: Benedícam te * in vita mea, Dómine: et in nómine tuo levábo manus meas, allelúia.
text.en: I will bless thee all my life long * and in thy name I will lift up my hands, alleluia.

text.la: Tres púeri * iussu regis in fornácem missi sunt, non timéntes flammam ignis, dicéntes: Benedíctus Deus, allelúia.
text.en: The three young boys * cast into the furnace by the king, fearing not the flames of fire, said: Blessed be God, alleluia.

text.la: Allelúia, * laudáte Dóminum de cælis, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: Alleluia, * praise ye the Lord from the heavens, alleluia, alleluia.

text.la: Benedíctio, et cláritas, et sapiéntia, et gratiárum áctio, honor, virtus, et fortitúdo Deo nostro in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
text.en: Benediction, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, honour, and power, and strength to our God for ever and ever. Amen.

v.en: The Lord reigns, he is clothed with beauty.

r.la: Índuit Dóminus fortitúdinem, et præcínxit se virtúte.
r.en: The Lord is clothed with strength, and has girded Himself with power.

text.la: Nolíte sollíciti esse * dicéntes: Quid manducábimus aut quid bibémus? scit enim Pater vester quid vobis necésse sit, allelúia.
text.en: Take no thought, saying: What shall we eat? * or: What shall we drink? For your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, alleluia.

text.la: Custódi, Dómine, quǽsumus, Ecclésiam tuam propitiatióne perpétua: et quia sine te lábitur humána mortálitas; tuis semper auxíliis et abstrahátur a nóxiis et ad salutária dirigátur.
text.en: Keep, we beseech thee, O Lord, thy Church with thy perpetual mercy, and because the frailty of man without thee cannot but fall, keep us ever by thy help from all things hurtful, and lead us to all things profitable to our salvation.

title.en: Immaculate Heart of the Blessed Virgin Mary

text.la: O beáta Virgo María: tu grátiæ Mater, tu spes mundi, exáudi nos fílios tuos clamántes ad te.
text.en: O Blessed Virgin Mary: thou Mother of grace, thou hope of the world, hear us, thy children, who cry to thee.

v.la: Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
v.en: Grace is poured into thy lips.

r.la: Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
r.en: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

text.la: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui in Corde beátæ Maríæ Vírginis dignum Spíritus Sancti habitáculum præparásti: concéde propítius; ut eiúsdem immaculáti Cordis festivitátem devóta mente recoléntes, secúndum Cor tuum vívere valeámus.
text.en: Almighty everlasting God, who hast prepared in the heart of Blessed Virgin Mary a worthy dwelling of the Holy Ghost, grant favourably to us that we may keep the feast of the same Immaculate Heart devoutly, and may be able to live according to thy heart.

office.title: Dominica XIV Post Pentecosten IV. Augusti
